entities.summary: Theodora Dimova (b. 1960-09-19, Sofia) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sofia and Bulgaria. Known in the fields of bulgaria, poets & playwrights, europe.
